run_CrawlDomain_main: run the CrawlDomain main function to generate k-shot data for multiple seeds
create_CrawlDomain_instance: create a CrawlDomain dataset instance with crawl_domain HuggingFace identifier and MIT license
load_CrawlDomain_dataset: load the crawl_domain dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
map_CrawlDomain_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of normalized and original text tuples
generate_CrawlDomain_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from CrawlDomain with a specified seed
